reviews.text: I've been taking my dogs to this clinic for five years, and I couldn't be more grateful. They see three of our family dogs with completely different personalities: one is super affectionate, another is very nervous, and my brother's dog is extremely fearful. They have incredible patience, empathy, and skill with each of them, respecting their pace and making them feel safe. They are incredibly professional and empathetic, not only with the animals but also with the people.

Incredible professionals with many years of experience, highly recommended. I've been going to them for many years; I have a cat named Nala and they treat her with so much love. I had another cat and they treated him his whole life. They try to cause the least amount of stress to the pets, and it shows. Many thanks to the team at the Marqués de Jura Real Veterinary Center
Trustworthy with exceptional service, it's clear they are true professionals and animal lovers, and animals are their priority.

I took my cat to the vet because one day she suddenly started limping for no apparent reason, and stopped eating and drinking. They quickly suspected that what my cat had was more than just a bump and bruise, and they ran a test that unfortunately came back positive for feline leukemia, confirming their suspicions.

That was four years ago. Whenever we've needed them, they've treated us, even when they didn't have an opening, because they knew my cat's health was very fragile. They were always open to alternative and new treatments as they became available to improve my cat's life. When another hospital told me that my cat couldn't go on any longer and that she had to be euthanized, they looked for alternatives, not to take my money, but because with their experience they saw that it was a hasty option. Thanks to them, my cat lived another year, a year in which she played and lived a normal life.

Unfortunately, my cat's illness was incurable, and she ultimately lost, but all those emergency appointments, those "I'll make room for you," and that extra year they managed to gain are unforgettable.

It's true they rarely answer the phone, but it's worth going if you need them.

I went on a recommendation and I couldn't be happier. They explain things really well, they're incredibly kind, and very gentle with my cat. It's truly wonderful to find professionals who know how to treat people well and not just give diagnoses.
Maximum trust and excellent prices
Super attentive and very professional
Lovely and incredibly helpful. Thank you!

I have a cat with asthma. On the last visit, they asked me not to bring my cat, as she's quite difficult, and said they were only going to give me the medication and explain how to use it.
When I went to pay, they told me I was being charged for the check-up, which I didn't understand, since my cat wasn't actually examined at their request.
I understand being charged for a consultation, not for a check-up that wasn't performed, which I paid for anyway to avoid any conflicts, and I just want my cat to be well.
They interpreted my actions as me questioning the professional and the profession. It could have been a simple misunderstanding. I just wanted to know what I was paying for... Today they refused to schedule the appointment (even though I requested it days ago, I've been waiting almost a week) only to tell me now that they're canceling it because of what happened... So they're refusing the appointment. My cat is still sick, and I feel like they've taken advantage of me and my money. Zero concern for what's important, which I believe is our pets...

The service and professionalism at this clinic are wonderful.
Thank you for always treating Kira so well ❤️

I was recommended this clinic. I had been to other vets and wasn't happy with the rough treatment we received.
I understand that some people are more sensitive to this than others. For me, many vets can give a diagnosis, and it can be just as accurate, but my cat prefers to be treated with extra care and patience, avoiding unnecessary stress. I prefer to have things explained to me in detail so I can understand them and try different solutions that are effective and manageable, especially when the diagnoses are complicated.

You get that at this clinic.

I recommend it.
